fixtures.brief: A battered handheld emergency LED lantern. Compact battery base, six inset clear glass panes in an open protective metal cage, a visible warm LED emitter and a curved carrying handle. Light must escape the chamber. Finished industrial prop, longest dimension 1.5 units, grounded at y=0.
checks: six panes inside rail openings without overlap
visible emitter and credible local illumination

fixtures.brief: Une chaise japonaise en chêne avec quatre pieds, des traverses, une assise légèrement incurvée et un dossier cintré. Assemblages crédibles et bois mat, sans ornements. Hauteur 1.5 unité, sol y=0.
A two-tier carved limestone fountain with hollow basins and a short animated water cascade landing inside the lower basin. No gold. Height 1.5 units, ground y=0.
A walnut travel chest with iron corner fittings and a hinged lid that slowly opens and closes. Interior remains hollow, lid rotates around the rear edge, height .7 and width 1.5 units.
Un vase en céramique émaillée bleu nuit, col étroit et panse courbe. Montrer une ouverture réelle, un intérieur et une lèvre épaisse. Hauteur 1.5 unité.
A portable 1970s field radio with an angled front panel, recessed speaker grille, two tactile tuning knobs, a glass dial and a folding carry handle. Width 1.5 units. No invented printed text.
A weathered steel wheelbarrow with one spoked front wheel, an open tapered tray, two supporting legs and two handles. Length 1.5 units. Functional load-bearing construction.
A windswept bonsai pine growing from a shallow ceramic pot, exposed roots, tapered branching trunk and irregular clusters of needles. Height 1.5 units, natural asymmetry.
A polished bronze abstract sculpture of two interlocking curved ribbons, mounted on a small rough basalt base. Height 1.5 units. Preserve real negative space between the ribbons.
A deep teal upholstered reading chair with rounded cushions, visible seams, oak legs and a curved back. Height 1.5 units. Soft fabric should contrast with the structural wood.
A hand-cranked educational orrery with three orbiting spheres on separate brass arms above a wooden base. Height 1.5 units. Keep the bearings aligned and animate the arms at distinct speeds.
Une petite presse à vis de relieur avec deux montants, un plateau mobile, une vis centrale et une poignée transversale. Bois dur et acier, hauteur 1.5 unité.

A 16 by 16 metre Japanese stone courtyard at dusk. A central path at least 2 metres wide leads through a genuine gate opening to a small timber pavilion. Raised planted beds, finished eaves, stone paving and two warm lanterns. Continuous ground, grounded props and readable walking routes.

Un atelier de maintenance de 12 par 8 mètres avec deux établis, des étagères, une porte ouverte de 2 mètres, un sol continu et une allée centrale libre. Acier peint, béton et bois, éclairage industriel crédible.
A 24 by 20 metre forest clearing with sloping terrain, a winding footpath, a small stream and a wooden bridge. Trees and rocks meet the terrain, bridge connects both banks. No magical effects.

A 30 by 12 metre abandoned railway platform with repeated structural bays, a canopy, benches and open access stairs. Finished concrete, oxidized steel and glass roof panels. Keep the platform navigable.
A 20 metre coastal cliff scene with a lighthouse entrance connected by a 2 metre wide stone path, stairs with railing and layered rock strata. Preserve navigable ground and believable sea level.

Une bibliothèque de 18 par 10 mètres avec une mezzanine, un escalier, des rayonnages et une grande fenêtre cintrée. Sols porteurs, garde-corps, passages libres et matériaux bois/pierre/verre cohérents.

A playable Japanese garden game: move with WASD, collect exactly three copper bells, then reach the red gate to win. A roaming guardian can damage the player and cause defeat. Use GAME controls, collision, a visible player, a 16m garden and a working restart. Finished stone/wood materials.
Un jeu de labyrinthe de 12 mètres : trouver une clé, ouvrir la sortie et gagner. Joueur visible, murs infranchissables, commandes WASD, danger au sol, défaite et redémarrage fonctionnels.
A playable small sci-fi arena: dodge two patrolling robots and collect five power cells to win. WASD player movement, damage, health, fail state and restart. Real floor and cover, no external assets.
A playable top-down kart time trial around a closed 20m track: drive using GAME controls, pass three checkpoints in order, reach the finish to win, fail when time expires and restart cleanly.

A playable two-room workshop escape game: find a fuse in room one, activate a powered door with E and enter room two to win. WASD movement, collision, a countdown fail state and restart. Register separate levels.

Un petit jeu de survie dans une serre : éviter des drones pendant 30 secondes pour gagner, ramasser deux soins, perdre à zéro santé et pouvoir recommencer. Commandes GAME, obstacles solides et joueur visible.
